product_family: Online graphic design tool (getstencil.com) for creating social media graphics, blog headers, and ads; browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox; WordPress plugin. NOTE: service is being permanently shut down on July 10, 2026.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No trust center page exists (getstencil.com/security returns 404, getstencil.com/trust returns 404). No mention of SOC 2 on the privacy policy, EU GDPR page, or Terms of Use.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not referenced on any vendor-domain page reviewed.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Vendor maintains a separate EU data protection page and states it was 'initially prepared in order to be compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) rules.' However, the main privacy policy was last updated December 18, 2019 and no DPA is publicly available. Posture is self-declared and unaudited.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence and not applicable — product is a graphic design tool that does not handle protected health information.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Payment processing is delegated to Stripe and PayPal per the EU privacy page. No PCI DSS claim made by vendor. Credit card data is not stored on Stencil servers per the privacy policy: 'After a transaction, your private information (credit cards, financials, etc.) will not be stored on our servers.'

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable — Stencil is not an AI product. No AI features are described on the vendor site.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence and not applicable for a small Canadian graphic design startup.

privacy.ai_training_note: Not applicable. Stencil is a non-AI graphic design tool. No AI model training or inference features are described anywhere on the vendor site.
privacy.data_region: Not explicitly stated. Third-party services include Amazon AWS (implied US/global). EU GDPR page references over 30 sub-processors including Google Analytics, Stripe, PayPal, and Mailgun without specifying storage regions.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: SSL/TLS (SSL certificates mentioned); PGP encryption protocols also referenced in EU privacy page

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Role-based administrator permissions limiting data exposure; restricted database and server access

security.name: Credential management
security.value: Password and API key rotation mentioned

security.name: Data breach response
security.value: EU GDPR page describes a breach protocol: disable access, change credentials, notify users, investigate, and implement preventative changes. No SLA or notification timeframe stated.

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: Bug Bounty link appears in site footer, but target URL was not captured in evidence; no program details confirmed

security.name: Credit card storage
security.value: Not stored on Stencil servers; handled by Stripe and PayPal

products.name: Stencil Web App
products.category: Graphic Design / Social Media Image Creation
products.data_scope: User account data (name, email, IP), uploaded images, fonts, logos; social account tokens if social sharing is used; payment data routed through Stripe/PayPal

products.name: Stencil Chrome Extension
products.data_scope: Same as web app; operates in-browser

products.name: Stencil WordPress Plugin
products.data_scope: Same as web app; integrates with WordPress editorial workflow

compare.pricing_model: Freemium; monthly and yearly subscription tiers (exact pricing not captured). 7-day money-back guarantee. Prices denominated in USD.
compare.data_residency: Not specified; third-party sub-processors include US-based AWS, Google, Stripe, PayPal, Mailgun

flags: The Stencil homepage displays 'Stencil service ends on July 10' (2026); the service is being permanently discontinued. Buyers should not rely on Stencil as an active tool.
The main privacy policy was last updated December 18, 2019, over 6 years ago. The EU GDPR sub-page carries no date stamp.
No SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or any other formal security certification is held or claimed, and no trust center exists.
No Data Processing Agreement is publicly available; GDPR compliance is self-declared with no audit or DPA offering.
The EU GDPR page references 'PGP encryption protocols' alongside SSL, an unusual and unverified claim for a web SaaS product, with no third-party audit to substantiate it.
Over 30 sub-processors are listed, including advertising and analytics services, with no data residency commitments stated.
The legal entity is Anchor Labs Inc., a small Ontario (Canada) corporation with no public financial disclosures or audited security posture.
